data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in maximum 30 large cap stocks
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the scheme is to seek to generate capital appreciation & provide long-term growth opportunities by investing in a focused portfolio of Large Cap – ‘blue chip’ – companies. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and equity related instruments of Large cap companies(including units issued by REITs)  :- 65 - 100% Other equity and equity related instruments (including units issued by REITs):- 0-35% Debt & Money Market instruments:- 0-35% Units issued by InvITs:- 0-10%
data.exit_load: For redemptions / switch outs (including SIP/STP) within 15 days from the date of allotment of units, irrespective of the amount of investment: 1% No exit load shall be applicable on switches from Regular Plan to Direct Plan and vice versa, under the same scheme.
